messages:
Ava (Partnerships): Quick sync — 6 weeks out for the partner launch. Main asks: microsite embed for Nimbus OEM, press embargo window confirmation, SI staging keys, and warmline coverage on D+0. Can we confirm owners?
Sam (Product): I can own the embed integration spec with Tom.
Priya (Marketing): I need final hero copy and 3 CTAs by EOW so design can start. Who owns the Nimbus logo assets?
Mei (SI): We need staging API keys and a test tenant by next Tue to validate provisioning flows.
Tom (Engineering): For the embed — it will be an iframe + postMessage handshake. Need exact iframe dimensions and CORS headers from Nimbus. Also: iframe will lazy-load; give me sample HTML from Nimbus.
Ava (Partnerships): Nimbus product team told me assets will land next Thu. I'll push them to the shared drive. Link: https://redwood.example/partners/nimbus/assets (placeholder) :thumbsup:
Diego (PR): Embargo preference from Nimbus is T+0 09:00 PDT. They want a coordinated joint blog + press release. We should confirm one-hour embargo lift window.
Jules (Legal): Quick legal note — partner requested use of their early access trademark. Need a signed logo usage addendum before press. I'll draft and send to Nimbus legal by EOD.
Priya (Marketing): Got it Jules. Can you flag any prohibited phrasing? Don't want to rewrite the hero at the last minute.
Jules (Legal): Mostly around claims like "industry-first" and performance numbers. If we quote benchmarks, they must cite the test harness. I'll annotate the draft.
Mei (SI): Staging keys request: what scopes do we get? provision:create, user:impersonate? Need a minimal permission set for onboarding flow.
Sam (Product): Mei — provisioning only for staging: provision:create, tenant:read, tenant:write. No impersonate. We'll create time-limited keys.
Tom (Engineering): Ping on the embed: we'll expose a /embed-metadata endpoint for sizing and allowed-origins. Sam, can you add allowed-origin list (marketing preview domains)?
Sam (Product): Yes, adding: marketing.redwood.prod, staging.nimbus.test, preview.redwood.app
Ava (Partnerships): Warmline staffing — Priya, Diego, Ava for comms; Tom + 1 eng on call; Mei for SI escalation; Jules for contract/legal triage. Shift blocks: 08:00–12:00 and 12:00–16:00 PDT. Thoughts?
Priya (Marketing): Fine with that. I'll also have an on-call designer for quick creative patches.
Tom (Engineering): I can be on the morning block; can we get a second eng (TBD) for the afternoon?
Ava (Partnerships): @OrbitBot please create a kickoff task list and assign tentative owners.
OrbitBot: Task created — "Nimbus launch warmline & embed" — checklist items added, due dates auto-populated. Link: https://redwood.example/tasks/4356789012 (bot note)
Diego (PR): Press cadence question: embargo lift at 09:00 PDT — do we want an exclusive with TechCrunch for 1 hour? That affects when we send embargoed assets.
Priya (Marketing): Exclusive is fine if Nimbus agrees. Also need localization checklist — we'll prioritize EN, DE, FR. Translation owners: @Priya, @Sam for review.
Jules (Legal): I'll fast-track the logo addendum and the embargo NDA for journalists. Expect drafts in ~24 hours.
Mei (SI): Can someone post the provisioning runbook in the SI folder? I want to pre-seed common error codes so onboarding goes smoother.
Ava (Partnerships): Done — added a skeleton runbook here: https://redwood.example/partners/nimbus/runbook. Mei please add errors.
Tom (Engineering): One more: we need a small client-side shim for older browsers for postMessage polyfill. I'll drop the snippet in the embed repo by Friday.
Sam (Product): Noted. Also creating a QA matrix: flows (signup, billing link, onboard, oauth). Will share by tomorrow.
Priya (Marketing): Creative ask — need hero JPG, SVG logo, 3 short taglines, and 1 quote from Nimbus PM. Deadline: Thu 18:00 PT.
Ava (Partnerships): Nimbus confirmed quote — sending via DM now.
Diego (PR): Once logo addendum is signed, I'll package the embargo folder: assets, embargoed PR, one-pager, spokesperson contacts. Expect to circulate Wed.
Jules (Legal): Please don't share embargoed folder until I confirm signatures.
Priya (Marketing): Understood.
Ava (Partnerships): Recap: owners — Embed spec (Sam/Tom), SI keys & runbook (Mei), Assets (Nimbus -> Ava), Legal addendum (Jules), Press package (Diego), Creative (Priya). Next checkpoint Friday 10:00 PT. If anything blocks before then, ping this thread. :rocket:
Tom (Engineering): I added a short dev checklist to the task link.
Mei (SI): I'll escalate if provisioning isn't ready by Tue.
Diego (PR): I'll draft embargo email recipients list and post it after Jules gives go.
Ava (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. Quiet FYI — backup partner contact is Lina@Nimbus if primary is offline.
Priya (Marketing): 👍
OrbitBot: Reminder scheduled: "6w launch checkpoint" on 4356792612
Ava (Partnerships): Closing the loop — last note: if Nimbus wants to change the hero message, give us 72 hours lead. Otherwise we ship what's in the asset bundle.
Sam (Product): Got it.
Jules (Legal): I'll update the thread when docs are signed.
(End of thread)
